Transient survives errors.Is/As and wraps; an unmarked error and nil are not transient
each listed stderr phrase is transient; a rejected push and auth failures are not
a run is transient only when every project's failure is
below the threshold: no incident, fail_count counts, backoff escalates
at the threshold: one WARN-0032 naming the job, the count and the cause; no WARN-0001
a non-transient failure is WARN-0001 on its first run, after transient ones too
WARN-0032 is in the catalog, documented, and its number recorded as spent
a successful run clears the open WARN-0032
a failed clear is not the run's error
